Question: the k series stock outperformed the s&p 500 by what percent over 5 years?
Response: From the given information, we can see that the DISCK (Series C Common Stock) had a value of $83.69 on December 31, 2008 and a value of $235.63 on December 31, 2011.

The S&P 500 index had a value of $74.86 on December 31, 2008 and a value of $104.23 on December 31, 2011.

To calculate the outperformance of DISCK over the S&P 500 over the 5-year period, we can use the following formula:

Outperformance = (DISCK 2011 / DISCK 2008) / (S&P 500 2011 / S&P 500 2008) - 1

Plugging in the values:
Outperformance = (235.63 / 83.69) / (104.23 / 74.86) - 1
            = 2.82 / 1.39 - 1
            = 103.6%

Therefore, the DISCK (Series C Common Stock) outperformed the S&P 500 by 103.6% over the 5-year period from December 31, 2008 to December 31, 2011.
